prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / view derivation. Draw a clean THREE-VIEW-plus-rear design sheet for the exact undersea train in the reference. Wide landscape ivory canvas. Layout: upper half has one long exact LEFT SIDE elevation, both sections visible, vehicle facing left at its left cab; lower half has one long TOP plan, same scale/length and orientation as upper side; on a narrow right column show FRONT end elevation above and REAR end elevation below. Simple thin divider lines, no words, no scenery, no arrows, no human/robot parts. Orthographic-looking technical design, no perspective hero views. KINETIC_CEL precise ink and color style same as reference.

Absolute geometry roster: ONE train, EXACTLY TWO equal-length cab-ended sections, joined flat coupling ends at ONE dark CENTRAL articulated coupler. Exactly TWO blue-glazed CAB NOSES at the two extreme OUTER ends, pointing away from the middle. No cab in the center, no third carriage. Each half has the same ivory streamlined shell, thin upper orange stripe plus strong orange lower side stripe, blue-black window band, compact graphite underbody, small orange hinge tabs and short ivory fold-flat side stabilizer vanes. Keep the same window and door panel family mirrored end-for-end on both halves. They are two matching left/right arm-shell sources when separated.

SIDE: camera exactly perpendicular to train side, equal-length mirrored halves; first cab at far left, second cab far right, central coupling at geometric middle. All vertical edges vertical and parallel, no far-side windows or visible front face. TOP: nose shapes at both far ends, one middle coupling; the shell has one longitudinal split seam per half and paired little foldable side vanes, shown at the same positions as reference. FRONT and REAR: opposite cab ends are the same matching compact white/orange nose with broad blue windshield; show matching fold-flat vanes and dark bottom chassis. Do not substitute a coupling-end view for the far cab end. The top/side should agree in total length, section lengths, seam and fin locations; vehicle closed in all four views. No firing effects, robot fists, extra wings, tank tracks or texts.
